caption: Figure 12: Measurement and calibration – A2L generation The basic information about which data to measure or calibrate and how to interpret it is stored in the description of each software component. However, the information on C-symbols required to identify the data is not directly available in the the Component Type Description. We need an intermediate work product per ECU, called ECU flat description, which contains this information. Note that this work product could be an intermediate format for the RTE generation activity, so it makes sense to combine the ativity Generate flat description of SW per ECU with the RTE generator.
